items.prompt: Map the information architecture: header with message-driven prompts, left drawer, and a feed of deliverables.
items.title: IA + component outline
items.bodyHtml:
Layout: sticky header (menu tab + prompt strip), full-height scroll region for cards.

Drawer: lists the same prompts as full text; choosing one scrolls the matching deliverable into view.

Feed: cards render in order; each card shows a numbered timestamp and a collapsible body for the completed artifact.

items.prompt: Use plain HTML/CSS/JS only: collapsible sections with accessible controls, sequential reveal, reduced-motion fallback.
items.title: Implementation constraints
items.bodyHtml:
Each slab is a <details> row; the summary bar toggles the finished work underneath.

  • Sequential load uses timeouts; disabled when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
  • Drawer uses a push layout (main surface slides); Escape closes.

items.prompt: Visually separate 'conversation intent' (prompts in the menu) from 'shipped output' (cards). Timestamps must read as #n · time.
items.title: UX split: prompts vs shipped work
items.bodyHtml:
Prompts stay compact in the header strip so intent stays visible while you review work product below.

Each finished block is a card with a top-right stamp #01 · … for scanability.

items.prompt: Wire sequential loading so later cards appear after earlier ones, simulating async handoffs.
items.title: Staggered feed
items.bodyHtml: Cards start hidden, then gain .card--visible on a staggered timer so the feed reads like progressive completion.
